sources.title: Gemma (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The first version was released in February 2024, followed by Gemma 2 in June 2024, Gemma 3 in March 2025, and the open-weights Gemma 4 in April 2026. Variants of Gemma have also been developed, such as the vision-language model PaliGemma and the model MedGemma for medical consultation topics.
